stories.title: Second fly-tipping incident at protected site near Halkyn, NRW says
stories.summary: Used motor oil has been fly-tipped for a second time at Moel-y-Crio near Halkyn, Flintshire, Natural Resources Wales has said. NRW attended the site alongside North Wales Police’s Rural Crime Team after reports that several drums of oil had been dumped. stories.title: “Ministers have run out of excuses”: Fflint Wrecsam MS reacts to Wales’ worst UK PISA showing
stories.summary: Nigel Williams MS has called for an overhaul of how Welsh pupils are taught reading, writing and maths after Wales recorded the lowest scores of any UK nation in the latest PISA international education rankings, published on Wednesday.
